title: HOT MINUTE
lines: Hot minute is a video store the size of a city.
It keeps 949 shots from 129 films. Every film is a tower, every shot a floor, every frame a window.
Its 6 streets are the scenes of the poem, in order: the first is “Harbor, temple, Atlantis dissolve into haze”.
The tallest tower is Mirror of America (1963): 36 floors.
Nothing in it is older than 1903 or newer than 2015.
The sign most often read here is binomial.
